name: Wren AI
summary: Conversational BI and text-to-SQL platform, with a paid cloud (unlimited users, credit-based) and a free open-source CLI for developers.
description: Conversational BI and text-to-SQL platform, with a paid cloud (unlimited users, credit-based) and a free open-source CLI for developers. Not to be confused with Wren by Seldon.

pricing.details: The cloud trial requires a card, and the free open-source option is a CLI with no UI; no lasting 0 € cloud plan was stated. Essential Cloud 162 €/month billed annually, or 234 € month-to-month — 13,200 annual credits included (about 3,000 questions a month on gpt-5.6-luna); 7-day free trial (a credit card is required; “activate without a card” is talk to sales); unused credits roll over up to 2×; additional credits beyond the included pool are available; per-unit credits are not displayed in euros; +20 free monthly credits for testing new features (expire at month-end, no rollover). Enterprise Cloud 506 €/month billed annually, or 723 € month-to-month — 24,000 annual credits included (about 5,500 questions a month on gpt-5.6-luna), same trial and overage rules, plus row/column-level controls, unlimited integrations, advanced RBAC and audit logs, custom LDAP/AD & OIDC, priority support. Enterprise Plus (self-hosted, session-based, annual contract) is contact sales.
pricing.label: Premium

features: Conversational BI and text-to-SQL, with agentic and classic question modes, dashboards and an MCP server
Cloud plans include unlimited users, dashboards, spreadsheets and projects, billed on credits
A 7-day cloud trial requires a card; the free open-source option is a CLI with no UI
There is no permanent free cloud tier; Enterprise Plus self-hosting is priced on request
